Auth.//: Not a secret, ships in the Flutter client anyway. AllowDevBypass defaults off here and is only turned on in appsettings.Development.json, on top of the IsDevelopment() check in Program.cs - two conditions, so an env var alone can never disable auth on a deployed instance.

Places.//: Google Places API (New) key. Leave blank to disable place search — spots can still be added manually. Set it via user-secrets or the Places__ApiKey environment variable rather than committing it here.
